purpose: Selection guidance for reviewed offline dashboard visuals; unsupported families are documented fallbacks.

families.label: KPI / card
families.required_grain: one reviewed headline

families.label: Horizontal bar
families.required_grain: ordered same-grain categories with supplied bounded size
families.misuse: missing size, mixed currency, causal ranking

families.label: Column
families.required_grain: ordered categories with supplied bounded height

families.label: Grouped bar
families.required_grain: common category and explicit series grain

families.label: Grouped / stacked / 100% stacked
families.required_grain: mutually exclusive segments with supplied shares

families.label: Lollipop / dot
families.required_grain: ordered rows with supplied bounded size

families.label: Bullet
families.required_grain: actual, target, range on one unit

families.label: Diverging bar
families.required_grain: signed supplied geometry and true zero

families.label: Waterfall
families.required_grain: ordered additive bridge with verified subtotal semantics

families.label: Donut / pie
families.required_grain: 2-5 mutually exclusive categories, denominator, shares
families.misuse: too many slices or implied denominator

families.label: Waffle
families.required_grain: donut contract plus 100 presentation cells
families.misuse: cells as observations or recalculated shares

families.label: Treemap
families.required_grain: hierarchical non-overlapping positive values

families.label: Funnel
families.required_grain: ordered stage populations with stage semantics

families.label: Line / area / slope
families.required_grain: at least two ordered periods at one grain

families.label: Scatter / bubble
families.required_grain: row-level x/y and optional reviewed size

families.label: Histogram / box
families.required_grain: raw or binned distribution

families.label: Pareto
families.required_grain: ordered categories plus supplied cumulative basis

families.label: Heatmap / matrix
families.required_grain: two dimensions and cell values

families.label: Small multiples
families.required_grain: repeated panels with labeled independent scales

families.label: Sankey / flow
families.required_grain: verified edges and weights

families.label: Timeline / Gantt
families.required_grain: events with start/end

families.label: Control chart
families.required_grain: ordered observations and reviewed limits

families.label: Metric grid
families.required_grain: exact label/value tiles with no geometry

families.label: Table
families.required_grain: reviewed rows/columns

families.label: Network / ontology graph
families.required_grain: explicit nodes and directed labeled links
